episodes.title: Do You Want To Take Revenge? / Maria's Case
episodes.summary: A mysterious taxi appears in front of Cho Do Chul, a sexual predator, who is released from prison today. Do Ki picks Cho Do Chul up with his taxi and disappears. Maria, a girl from an orphanage attempts to commit suicide from Han River Bridge, and Do Ki comes and saves her. He listens to her tragic story and decides to help. Part 2: Maria requests Rainbow Deluxe Taxi to help her get her revenge. Do Ki and his team prepare themselves and start investigating the factory Maria worked at. Meanwhile, Ha Na tries to find where Cho Do Chul went to and realizes that there is something weird about the deluxe taxi he was in.

episodes.title: Do Ki Meets Ju Chan/Missing Taxi
episodes.summary: Do Ki joins Sung Chul in the taxi service business after his mother's death. He manages to sneak into Ju Chan's factory and even puts in an order for their food products. As Do Ki and his team carry out the investigation, they realize that Ju Chan did not only abused disabled workers but also committed frauds to embezzle more money. Ha Na finds the deluxe taxi which Cho Do Chul took but it was all burnt down. She wants to investigate Cho Do Chul's case further, but the chief prosecutor stops her. She decides to visit Rainbow Transport by herself. Meanwhile, Do Ki and Sung Chul kidnap all three of Ju Chan's people one by one.

episodes.title: A Victim of a School Violence/My Pictures Are In The Bag
episodes.summary: When Ha Na questions Sung Chul about the deluxe taxi that went missing, she finds out that he has a setback of losing both of his parents to murder. Meanwhile, A young boy from high school who lives with his deaf mother, gets in touch with Rainbow Deluxe Taxi to take revenge on his bullies.

episodes.title: The Deluxe Taxi Appears/Teacher vs Students
episodes.summary: No matter how hard Seung-tae tries to sabotage Do-ki, the Rainbow Deluxe Taxi crew manages to handle the situation with its fancy equipment. Furthermore, the three of them accidentally purchase drugs, and Do-ki stresses them out by threatening them. Therefore, Seung-tae decides to call someone for help. Meanwhile, Do-ki and Ha-na meet again at the meeting of Blue Bird members.

episodes.title: The Case of Young Min/The Evil Businessman
episodes.summary: Do Ki wakes up from a nightmare after fainting on the street. Although everyone worries about his health, he still chooses to keep working without taking a break. Meanwhile, Ha Na visits Mr. Jang to discuss something. But before she does, she gets a chance to observe a victim-sharing session, which makes a small change in her heart. Do Ki gets his hands on the Seo Young Min case file. Ha Na also goes after this case despite Jin Woo's strict orders to drop it. Now, both Do Ki and Ha Na are after the cruel owner of U data to make him pay for what he did to Young Min. The question now is who will get to him first.

episodes.title: First Day of Work/Into the Strategic Planning Team
episodes.summary: Do Ki heads to U data for his first day of work. What he finds there is beyond anything any of them could have imagined. Chairman Park Yang Jin is practically worshipped by his employees. Once he figures out that the Strategic Planning Team is the core of the company, Do Ki does everything he can to get transferred there. Do Ki manages to find out what kind of people work on the Strategic Planning Team. After a rather extravagant display of his prowess, Do Ki finally gets transferred to the team. Meanwhile, Ha Na finds out about the Strategic Planning Team through Jin Woo. When Ha Na approaches Do Ki, Chairman Park Yang Jin wants to test Do Ki's overly zealous loyalty.

episodes.title: Do Ki Becomes An Informant/An Untimely Goodbye
episodes.summary: Jung Eun's suicide surfaces again, and her sister Go Eun gets a glimpse of what caused it all to happen. Sung Chul and Do Ki do what it takes to bring justice to those involved. Do Ki gets on to a lead and heads straight into the heart of where it all begins. Meanwhile, Ha Na asks Do Ki to be their informant. The chairman of U data pays a surprise visit to the prosecution and meets with Prosecutor Kang Ha Na. However, her accusations do not affect the chairman surrounded by his big law firm lawyers. Later, Do Ki calls Ha Na to catch them red-handed, but the prosecution's visit turns out to be worthless.

episodes.title: The Vacation Home/Destroying the Data Center
episodes.summary: Do Ki arrives at Park Yang Jin's vacation home with Jin Won. As he fails to harm Jin Won as Chairman Park commands him to, he ends up getting tied up as well. Meanwhile, Sung Chul attends a meeting at the Prosecutors' Office about the funding for the Blue Bird Foundation. Finally, Ha Na gets Jin Woo's approval to raid Chairman Park's vacation home. Go Eun returns to help Do Ki and the others finish Park Yang Jin and U data once and for all. With Go Eun back on his side, Do Ki reveals his identity to Chairman Park and locates the data mine as well. Meanwhile, Ha Na arrives at the vacation home with backup in tow, but when they arrive, Do Ki and his team are already finished with their plans.

episodes.title: The Aftermath Of The Explosion/The Voice Phishing Scam
episodes.summary: Ha Na finds Do Ki's employee identification card at Park Yang Jin's vacation home, or at least what's left of it after the explosion. She believes that someone stole her suspect and tried to cover up the evidence. As she grows more and more suspicious, Ha Na visits Do Ki to try to get some information out of him. Kyung Gu loses money to a voice phishing scam. When he goes to report it to the police, he realizes that he is not the only victim. Sung Chul and the team discuss whether they should take on this voice phishing ring as their next target. Once they decide to do so, Jin Eon and Do Ki go undercover.

episodes.title: Mr. Wang And Madam Lim/Going After Madam Lim's Account
episodes.summary: Do Ki disguises himself as a burner phone peddler, Mr. Wang, from Harbin. Using his good looks, he tries to win the heart of the boss of the voice phishing ring, Madam Lim. However, things start to get complicated when Ha Na arrives on the scene of their undercover operation and Jin Won's cover is blown. Do Ki pretends to be on the run from the law and tells Madam Lim that he must leave the following day. Not knowing that this is all part of Do Ki's plan, Madam Lim's feelings for Mr. Wang grow deeper. Meanwhile, Go Eun fiddles with Madam Lim's bank account and tricks her into revealing her bank information.

episodes.title: Searching Director Jang's House/Tracking Down the Missing Murder Victim
episodes.summary: Ha Na closes in on Do Ki and the Rainbow Transport team, and she decides to search Sung Chul's house. However, the search proves to be in vain as nothing suspicious turns up. Meanwhile, Do Ki meets the family of the victim in a murder case without a body. When he sees that the suspect is Chairman Baek's man, he contemplates what to do. Ha Na tries to find evidence that Gu Young Tae is guilty of murdering Ko Dong Hee, but it isn't an easy feat. She tries to get Sim Woo Sub, one of Gu Young Tae's men, to turn on him. However, as he finally gets some information, he gets into trouble. As Ha Na and Min Ho chase down the suspect, they walk straight into danger.

episodes.title: A Colleague's Funeral/Chairman Baek's Business
episodes.summary: After Min Ho's death, Ha Na is determined to catch his killer. She succeeds in having Gu Young Tae arrested, as he is the lead suspect in this case. However, without any real evidence, the prosecution has no choice but to set him free. Ha Na goes to Do Ki, who has already been chasing Gu Young Tae, and asks for his help. Ha Na questions Chairman Baek about MH Trading since she is their biggest investor, but she denies knowing anything about it or what they do. The investigation continues and it leads to the discovery of a large organ trafficking ring. Do Ki and the team at Rainbow Transport find a surprise when they go to the private jail.

episodes.title: Going Into The Embassy Of The Bahamas/A Prisoner Exchange
episodes.summary: Ha Na searches all over for Gu Young Tae, even calling Baek Sung Mi in for an interview and barging into the Embassy of the Bahamas where she has ties. Do Ki ends up finding Gu Young Tae, and Ha Na asks Do Ki to hand him over. However, Do Ki plans an exchange to get the criminals back. Ha Na implores Do Ki to hand over Gu Young Tae and to stop trying to get revenge, but Do Ki has a plan of his own. Meanwhile, Sung Mi suggests to the criminals that they get their revenge on the Rainbow Transport team. As Do Ki gets arrested, the criminals each go looking for their own revenge.

episodes.title: The Rainbow Transport Team In Danger/Do Ki Chases Down Baek Sung Mi
episodes.summary: The Rainbow Transport team faces off with Baek Sung Mi, Gu Seok Tae, and the criminals. Choi Min tries to film a video of Go Eun, just like he did with her sister Jung Eun. Do Ki and Jin Won must save the rest of the team and Do Ki shows up to save Go Eun just in time. However, Park Ju Chan rams a truck into the taxi that Jin Won is driving. Do Ki decides that he can't stand by and watch his people get hurt anymore, and he sets out for revenge, burning with rage. As Go Eun waits for Jin Won to get out of surgery, Do Ki goes to save Sung Chul and Kyung Gu. Ha Na and the police come to arrest the criminals, but Baek Sung Mi gets away. Finally, Do Ki chases her down.

episodes.title: Rainbow Transport Decides to Disband/The Last Case
episodes.summary: Sung Chul and Do Ki decide to disband Rainbow Transport and stop getting revenge. Do Ki tells Ha Na all about what they used to do. However, a man claiming to be the killer of Do Ki's mom suddenly appears and says that the man who was previously arrested for the crime was just lying. Ha Na and Jin Woo go and apologize to the man who was blamed for killing a teenage girl in place of Oh Chul Young. He contacts Rainbow Taxi, asking for revenge, but Sung Chul tries to refuse the case. However, Do Ki says that this will be their last case, not knowing what he is about to discover regarding his own mom's murder.

episodes.title: Revenge Against Oh Chul Young/One Year Later
episodes.summary: The notorious serial killer Oh Chul Young turns out to be the murderer who killed Do Ki's mother and Sung Chul's parents. Also, there is a man named Kim Chul Jin who had to serve 20 years in prison for a crime that Oh Chul Young committed. Despite Rainbow Transport's ups and downs, they decide to carry out their last revenge. Ha Na decides not to arrest Do Ki, even though he insists that he should be punished for his actions. A year goes by and Baek Sung Mi and the twins receive their final verdicts, while Oh Chul Young begs for forgiveness at Kim Chul Jin's retrial. The Rainbow Transport members also move onto the next chapter of their lives.

episodes.title: The Missing Son
episodes.summary: Despite the disbandment of Rainbow Taxi, Do Gi is still out there going after bad guys. While keeping it from the rest of the members, Do Gi and Seong Cheol secretly help out a father who is searching for his missing son. To confirm his whereabouts, Do Gi sets off abroad to a foreign country to accomplish his first mission.

episodes.title: Back in Business
episodes.summary: Do Gi successfully infiltrates Cheongeum with the help of his old crew. He pretends to be an abducted recruit but secretly searches for Dong Jae. During the search, he runs into Lim Bok Ja. He uses her revengeful anger to make it easier to find the missing boy. Just when he is about to capture the mastermind, a mysterious gunshot interrupts his arrest.

episodes.title: The Trot Singer
episodes.summary: An elderly woman visits Rainbow Transport as a victim. She owes a lot of money because of a young scammer who only rips money off old people. Do Gi and the team get infuriated upon seeing this and set up a plan to prevent this criminal from ever scamming the elderly again.

episodes.title: Sang Gi's Prison
episodes.summary: Rainbow Transport officially begins its operation to bring punishment to Sang Gi. The plan mainly depends on Seong Cheol being a loaded old man as bait. As soon as Sang Gi sees this and plans to scam him, he does not realize the karma that he is about to face. Meanwhile, the secret organization Do Gi is after is also keeping an eye on Do Gi as well.

episodes.title: Feel Consulting
episodes.summary: Do Gi runs into a stray little girl on the street. Out of concern, he takes her to Rainbow Transport and learns that suspicious people are after her. Do Gi and the team tries to infiltrate Feel Consulting and get some info on Kang Pil Seung to find out why he is in search of this poor little girl.

episodes.title: The Evil Uncle
episodes.summary: Do Gi and Go Eun get busted by Pil Seung for putting up an act. However, Do Gi manages to win back his trust by acting how desperate he is for a house. Now that they are back on track, Do Gi learns how Pil Seung is able to help couples get housing by using children. Disgusted by his ways, the team is determined to bring down Pil Seung at all costs.

episodes.title: The SunBaek Cult
episodes.summary: The following client is a woman named Lee Jin Hee. Her beloved sister Jin Sun is suffering from a terminal disease and is relying on a cult to cure her. Rainbow Transport begins service to save her from the cult and take down its leader. However, Do Gi is not the one who will be infiltrating the cult this time.

episodes.title: Beating Cult With a Cult
episodes.summary: The plan to destroy Ok Ju Man is now set. The only thing that remains is for Ju Man to take the bait. Although he does not have faith in any kind of religion, the Rainbow Transport team makes it seem believable. By setting the perfect scam, Ok Ju Man becomes faithful to the fake cult that Do Gi makes.

episodes.title: The Surgery Malpractice
episodes.summary: A smelly drunk man protests alone in front of a big hospital. He claims that his daughter is in a coma due to surgery malpractice. Although Rainbow Transport took him in as a client, they are not sure whether this is an actual case or just an accident. Before they start anything, Do Gi looks into Ahn Young Sook, the director who performed the surgery.

episodes.title: Jeil Chakhan Factory
episodes.summary: Do Gi becomes a patient himself to infiltrate the operating room. When he is put to sleep, Go Eun finds out that there is a proxy who does the actual surgery while Young Sook goes somewhere else for a drink. Now that the team knows she is a complete fraud, they set up a meticulous plan to bring the witch down.

episodes.title: The Late Kim Do Gi
episodes.summary: Do Gi makes it out alive from the car bomb explosion. He uses his death to track down the person behind the vicious attack. While his funeral progresses, Do Gi and the team monitor any suspicious people coming and going, which leads them to a club for the rich in Gangnam. Do Gi makes his entrance to find out more.

episodes.title: The Playground of Evil
episodes.summary: After Do Gil gets kicked out from Black Sun and gets beaten up, the police arrive. However, the police arrest Do Gi instead. Although Yong Min helps to bail him out, Do Gi now knows that the police are working with Black Sun. Rainbow Transport infiltrates the club to take them down for all the crimes they are committing.

episodes.title: Do Gi Crashes the Party
episodes.summary: An angry VIP client at Black Sun puts the security team on edge. The security team gets a second chance to make another delivery. Only this time, Do Gi joins the team. What he learns is shocking. Meanwhile, Seong Cheol digs into Ha Jun's past.

episodes.title: Ha Jun's Defeat
episodes.summary: While Do Gi wakes up from getting drugged, the bishop comes back to Korea. Now that Do Gi has evidence of how Black Sun is circulating drugs, he sets up a plan. Meanwhile, Ha Jun notices that Rainbow Transport is on Black Sun's tail. Knowing how skillful Do Gi is, he takes every precaution he can.

episodes.title: Ha Jun Versus Do Gi
episodes.summary: Rainbow Transport takes in another client. However this time, it is a set-up made by the Bishop and Ha Jun. Not knowing that it is a trap, Do Gi blindly goes into Jangsan Correctional with Gyeong Gu and Jin Eon to save a victim. The only thing that is waiting for him is Ha Jun's trap that will break Do Gi into pieces.

episodes.title: The Final Client
episodes.summary: Do Gi goes into Jangsan Correctional as an undercover inmate. He fights all the way through every trap that Ha Jun has prepared for him. Although he barely makes it in one piece, he saves Lee Si Wan. Meanwhile, Ha Jun learns about his true identity and what the Bishop has done to him since his childhood.
